{{Quote|The TIE fighter is the mainstay of the Imperial Flight Branch'' [&hellip;]|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Conan Antonio Motti/Legends|Conan Antonio Motti]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''|<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
The '''Flight Branch''' was a division of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] responsible for overseeing the flight operations of combat [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. It was also responsible for all of the Empire's starfighters, including the pilots and support personnel, through the Navy's [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]].<ref name="Handbook" /> It included the [[Flight Division]], and several smaller support divisions.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The [[Navy Order of Battle]] was under the purview of the Flight Branch.<ref name="ISB2">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> Within the branch, junior specialist officers from captain downward had the prefix of "Flight" in front of their rank, to signify their affiliation to the branch. They also had positional titles for the pilots within the branch, including [[Squadron Leader/Legends|squadron leader]], [[Wing Commander/Legends|wing commander]], and [[Group Captain|group captain]]. Personnel within the Flight Branch who ended up promoted beyond the rank of [[General/Legends|General]] within the specialist ranks often retained their honorific branch title of [[Air Marshal|air marshal]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
